Quamdiu verò hic Incendii febrilis fomes
intra Reipub: viscera retinebitur; nulla nobis

cunq; enim machinabimur, quibuscunq; em-

page.notes: Scan is slightly skewed and the right-margin notes are partly cut off, so their wording is uncertain and marked [?]. "Expulsionis Ie-suitarum" and "Particularis purgatio" are read from partial letters. The header page number is read as 243 and may be partly obscured. The first line's initial letter looks like "l" but is most likely long s (s) of "sunt", so it is transcribed as "iunt;". "metuth" and "minus" are doubtful readings. The final paragraph continues onto the next page.
